suite: Suite PR #556 (Pump and Compressor Station Designer Full precision switch, stacked on #554)

beginner.why: The Duty Point cards round flow and head to whole units and power to 1 decimal against tolerances of 5e-7 to 1e-4; there was no discharge pressure stat.

escravos_duty_flow_gpm.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

escravos_duty_head_ft.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

escravos_hydraulic_hp.display_ref: src/components/pumpstudio/PumpPanels.jsx DutyResults, hydraulic hp hint under Brake power
escravos_hydraulic_hp.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

escravos_brake_hp.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

escravos_motor_input_kw.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

escravos_discharge_psi.display_ref: src/components/pumpstudio/PumpPanels.jsx DutyResults, Duty head as pressure (shown only with Full precision on; engine headFtToPsi)
escravos_discharge_psi.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rotatingFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

beginner.append: Read the figures in the Pump Station Designer with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
